answer: A practical sybil defense is a non-transferable bond paired with continuous, non-amortizable work: every identity must post stake and keep completing verified tasks whose history cannot be copied across accounts. Forging many identities is like trying to heat metal at a forge without owning the anvil; each fake account still needs its own sustained labor. Reputation accrues slowly, so a cluster cannot leap from a narrow ledge of fresh accounts to the zenith of trusted status overnight.
